title: Passage 32
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Tea and coffee are two of the most popular drinks in the world, however,
sentences.cn: 茶和咖啡是世界上最受欢迎的两种饮品，不过，

sentences.en: people usually prefer one more than the other.
sentences.cn: 人们通常会更偏爱其中一种。

sentences.en: Sometimes people argue about which is better.
sentences.cn: 有时，人们还会争论哪一种更好。

sentences.en: Tea drinking started in China over 4,000 years ago.
sentences.cn: 喝茶始于4000多年前的中国。

sentences.en: These days, some people drink tea for health or losing weight.
sentences.cn: 如今，有些人喝茶是为了健康或减重。

sentences.en: However, most people think of tea as more than just a healthy drink.
sentences.cn: 然而，大多数人都认为茶已经不仅仅是一种健康饮品。

sentences.en: In fact, tea drinking has become a kind of culture.
sentences.cn: 事实上，喝茶已经成为了一种文化。

sentences.en: Tourists are often happy to be part of the local tea culture.
sentences.cn: 游客们通常都很乐于融入当地的茶文化中。

sentences.en: You might imagine that in the past, people gathered in a noble person's house at 3 o'clock p.m.
sentences.cn: 你可以想象一下，在过去，人们在下午三点聚集在一位名门望族人士的家中。

sentences.en: The hostess greets each guest and begins to pour tea into their cups.
sentences.cn: 女主人迎接每位客人，并开始为他们倒茶。

sentences.en: In Turkey, tea is always there when people meet, whether offered in someone's home, a company or at a restaurant.
sentences.cn: 在土耳其，人们见面时总是会有茶，无论是在某人家中、公司里还是在餐厅。

sentences.en: In the UK, homes and offices usually have afternoon tea time when tea and other snacks are served.
sentences.cn: 在英国，家中和办公室里通常都有下午茶时间，会提供茶和其他点心。

sentences.en: People may use a spoon to mix milk and tea together and enjoy it with biscuits.
sentences.cn: 人们会用勺子把牛奶和茶混合，并搭配饼干一起享用。

sentences.en: It is a way of relaxing with friends or co-workers.
sentences.cn: 这是与朋友或同事一起放松的一种方式。

sentences.en: Coffee came just over 1,000 years ago.
sentences.cn: 咖啡只有1000多年的历史。

sentences.en: Coffee is made from beans.
sentences.cn: 咖啡是由咖啡豆制成的。

sentences.en: Something in the coffee beans makes a person feel active.
sentences.cn: 咖啡豆中的某些成分会让人感到活跃。

sentences.en: Many people drink coffee in the morning to help them wake up before going to their jobs.
sentences.cn: 许多人会在早上喝咖啡，以帮助他们在上班前清醒过来。

sentences.en: Others also drink coffee in the afternoon to keep going through the working day.
sentences.cn: 还有的人也会在下午喝咖啡，以维持一天的工作状态。

sentences.en: Some people may visit coffee shops just to meet and talk with friends.
sentences.cn: 有些人去咖啡店只是为了和朋友们见面、聊天。

sentences.en: However, many people in coffee shops drink coffee while working on their computers or reading some articles.
sentences.cn: 然而，许多人在咖啡店里一边喝咖啡一边用电脑工作或阅读一些文章。
